text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is finally underway. Symboli 
Kris S and her Trainer reviewed the 
challenges she needs to overcome while in 
the car on the way there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S steeled her resolve. She 
vowed to grow stronger over the summer
and 
claim victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
no matter what.
